name: imagenet-val-50000-original
source: ImageNet ILSVRC2012 validation set, all 50,000 images (1,000 classes x 50), original JPEGs (byte-identical to the ImageNet-100 val files of .cache/data/eval5000 where they overlap); images not redistributed
selection_rule: class i % n_classes (sorted synsets), file i // n_classes (sorted names), i = 0..n-1 (tools/build_eval_set.py select); each block of 1,000 consecutive samples has one image per class
preprocessing_note: tensors are not stored; tools/accuracy_full_val.py computes them per shard with each model's own preprocessing (registry/recipes.json eval.preprocess) and deletes them
limitations: Full validation set at original resolution; each model's own evaluation preprocessing is applied.
